thread:
Priya Nair: FYI support has a ticket where a stream that triggered a toolcall got truncated and resumed. console shows provisional + confirmed usage for the same request — customer thinks they were double-charged. anyone see this pattern? :confused:

Ben Walker: can you drop the request id and a tiny log excerpt? reconnect or server retry?

Priya Nair: client reconnect. snippet:
```
2026-03-12T09:12:01Z INFO stream:start sid=SID-x1
2026-03-12T09:12:05Z WARN stream:eof toolcall T-77
2026-03-12T09:12:06Z INFO router:resume sid=SID-y2 toolcall=T-77
2026-03-12T09:12:06Z INFO billing:provisional tok=210 rid=RID-77
2026-03-12T09:12:09Z INFO billing:confirmed tok=345 rid=RID-77
```

Liam O'Connor: root cause likely dedupe key uses session_id; when session rotates dedupe misses, so provisional and confirmed both counted.

Ben Walker: simple mitigation — prefer dedupe by request_id if present. fallback is harder.

Priya Nair: request_id exists here, but we can't rely on it globally. quick fix idea: hide provisional entries in the console chart when session mismatch on resume, to avoid customer confusion.

Liam O'Connor: agree for UI. backend fix: on confirmed, detect overlap with stored provisional prefix (store prefix_len/hash) and subtract overlap before finalizing ledger. Sam to write RFC.

Ben Walker: deploy window?

deploy-bot: Deploy window 2026-03-12 10:00-11:00 UTC. hotfix allowed with oncall approval.

Priya Nair: plan: hotfix console hide + small event tag (provisional.origin=resume) today. RFC + backend dedupe next sprint. I'll file the support note. :thumbsup:
